description: Whether Google Drive tells TrackerHacker when the person's sheets change, so what a sheet asks in its TH Actions tab reaches them with nothing installed in the sheet. It's on for everyone unless they turned it off. Leave out on to read how it stands: whether it's on and how many sheets are watched. Pass on true to turn it on and watch every Google sheet now (also restarts watches that haven't started yet), or false to turn it off and stop every watch. The Sheets add-on reports changes sooner than Drive does. Sheets shared by link aren't watched.

on.description: true turns it on and watches every sheet now; false turns it off. Leave out to read how it stands.

name: set_drive_watch
title: Watch sheets through Google Drive
